registry_contract.dependencies: G1-EXP-TENSOR-GPU-103, FourfoldSnapshot/PlaneSnapshot authority, retained IgnitionGraphDelta measurement

title: Close the missing revision-bound relation-delta seam before incremental Tensor design

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Search the existing Fourfold/Forest/Twin and adjacent Gate-1 graph-delta surfaces for an already-authoritative revision-bound delta or receipt that identifies changed retained relation digests. Reuse such a seam if it exists; otherwise retain the absence as evidence and do not invent an incremental backend, cache, second graph index or trusted relation admission path.

finding.summary: No existing authority-safe revision-bound relation-delta seam is available for Tensor incremental compilation. FourfoldSnapshot is revision-bound and PlaneSnapshot retains canonical same-plane relation digests, but it is a snapshot contract, not a before/after delta. The retained IgnitionGraphDelta is a Gate-1 measurement over node membership and cross-plane binding semantic keys only; it carries neither source revisions nor Forest identities and ignores PlaneSnapshot.relation_sha256s entirely.
finding.why_not_reuse_by_assumption: A pair of Fourfold snapshots can differ in source revision, source Forest digest and retained same-plane relation_sha256s while preserving every node id and cross-plane binding semantic key. The current IgnitionGraphDelta is then empty. Treating that empty measurement as an incremental relation receipt would silently miss exactly the one-relation update GPU-100 measured.
finding.unrelated_delta_surfaces: Repository-write delta contracts found elsewhere are Gate-0 repository inventory/write-surface measurements, not Forest/Fourfold semantic deltas. Reusing them would cross authority domains rather than consolidate an existing Tensor seam.
unsafe_shortcuts_rejected: reinterpret IgnitionGraphDelta as a relation delta without changing its contract
infer relation change from node or cross-plane binding change
diff Tensor blocks and treat the regenerable view as semantic authority
retain a mutable previous-snapshot cache inside the compiler
add a second digest-to-edge registry or trusted incremental admission path

focused_contract.new_case: construct base and candidate Fourfold snapshots with identical node membership and no cross-plane bindings but different source revisions, Forest digests and retained code-plane relation digests; prove fourfold_graph_delta remains empty and its serialized shape contains only node/binding fields

semantic_invariants.source_of_truth: Authoritative sources, KnowledgeForest and Fourfold remain truth; Tensor remains a regenerable internal computational view.
semantic_invariants.artifact_identity: A graph delta is not candidate identity and an incremental receipt must not replace revision/Forest identity.
semantic_invariants.relation_authority: Same-plane relation admission continues to require the exact retained canonical relation digest from the bound PlaneSnapshot.
semantic_invariants.no_parallel_owner: No second delta implementation, edge registry, cache or incremental compiler is introduced by this packet.
semantic_invariants.public_api: No production API, persisted schema, promotion contract or gate state changes.

result.summary: GPU-104 closes as negative Gardener evidence. Daedalus already has a graph-delta measurement, but it intentionally measures Gate-1 node/cross-plane-binding change rather than revision-bound same-plane relation change. Reusing it for Tensor would create false no-op deltas. The safe action is to preserve that boundary and pin the gap before designing any incremental contract.

claim_boundaries: No claim that a safe incremental relation contract is already designed.
No speedup claim; production code is unchanged.
No claim that IgnitionGraphDelta is defective for its Gate-1 purpose; only that its scope is intentionally insufficient for Tensor same-plane relation deltas.
No Tensor-vs-Forest, GPU/Tensor-Core, CrewAI or AlphaEvolve superiority claim.
No OwnerApproval, PromotionReceipt, merge, Ready-for-Review or Gate transition.
next_bounded_step: GPU-105 should inventory compile_relation_blocks call sites and retained projection consumers for an existing place that already owns both an authoritative previous and current Forest/Fourfold snapshot. If no caller naturally owns that before/after pair, close that wiring gap as evidence rather than hiding previous state in the compiler. If one does, specify the minimum revision/Forest-bound relation-digest delta inputs there before any production incremental path is written.
